食糧庁「米価に関する資料」。

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(gghighlight)
library(ggsci)

figdir <- "../fig"
dir.create(figdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

df <- read.csv("../data/price_of_rice.csv")

df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`政府買入価格`, `政府売渡価格`),
    names_to = "name",
    values_to = "value"
  )

g <- ggplot(
    data = df_long,
    aes(x = 会計年度, y = value, color = name)
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_color_d3() +
  labs(
    title = "米価の推移",
    y = "価格（円/60kg）",
    x = "会計年度",
    caption = "出典：食糧庁「米価に関する資料」"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Hiragino Sans")
  ) +
  gghighlight(
    line_label_type = "ggrepel_text",
    label_params = list(family = "Hiragino Sans")
  )

ggsave(
  "price_of_rice.pdf",
  plot = g,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  path = figdir,
  width = 8,
  height = 4
)
g
```
